scope.sourceAssets: The seven exact GLBs selected by the Crystal Promenade load plan. The optional Pearl Alcove lantern is excluded.
scope.desktop: High quality retains the original textures, geometry, silhouettes, materials, and two-bundle load limit.
scope.mobile: Auto selects Balanced for a primary coarse pointer or a mobile device hint. Balanced serializes bundle decode and caps color, normal, and emissive images at 1024 pixels and packed roughness, metalness, and occlusion images at 512 pixels before first renderer use.
scope.limitation: This is a local Chromium resource and lifecycle proof. It is not a physical iPhone 13 Pro reproduction, does not measure iOS process memory, and cannot establish that the reported TestFlight crash is resolved. A physical-device retest remains required.

measuredResourceBudget.method: glTF-Transform 4.4.2 inspect; texture upload estimates include a full RGBA mip chain
measuredResourceBudget.qualification: The upload totals are deterministic projections for the shipped sources, not a peak-RSS or resident-GPU-memory measurement. Geometry is unchanged.

chromiumProbe.environment: Playwright Chromium, 390x844 CSS pixels, deviceScaleFactor 3, touch and mobile enabled
chromiumProbe.runtimeResult: The full Promenade reached ready, forward movement exceeded 0.2 world units, remained ready, and emitted no page or console errors.

boundedLoading: bounds required GLB work so one renderer attempt cannot decode every bundle together
aborts the active GLB and never starts queued work after renderer teardown
cancellation: invalidates a standalone texture request and releases its late decoded image
stops between resizes and closes a replacement completed after abort
lifecycleEvidence.ownership: The renderer attempt tracks decoded image identity, disposes vessels, museum adapters, scenes, materials, and textures first, then closes each unique attempt-owned decoded image once. Shared images referenced through distinct Texture Sources are all replaced before the original is released.
lifecycleEvidence.independentReview: A source-frozen independent review found no image lifetime, cancellation, retry, or disposal blocker.
